k-manipulation-rules.alt: Three boxes. Reverse it: A + B forming C has K; C forming A + B has 1 over K. Multiply by n: doubling to 2A + 2B forming 2C gives K to the n, here K squared. Add reactions: A forming B with K1 and B forming C with K2 add to A forming C with K1 times K2. A note: coefficients are exponents in K, so scaling raises K to a power and adding multiplies K values; for one equation, only temperature changes K.
